digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend assembly and port conformance
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not implement query_project and assert_env_ready, failing isinstance(backend, Backend) conformance to the port protocol
reconciler.backend config choice is hardcoded to {"jira"}, making the registered jira-datacenter backend unreachable via configuration despite registry resolution
inbound DC assignee identities fail to mint because the guard gate demands accountId which DC users do not carry (they carry name/key instead), silently bypassing identity creation

the channel mapping from backend vendor to store family is missing, causing ValueError on creation_channel='jira-datacenter' which is not in CREATION_CHANNELS vocabulary when the accountId guard is bypassed
test_backend_contract.py fixture parametrization is limited to ["fake", "jira"], leaving the DC backend never validated against generic port assertions
the import contract has no reciprocal rule blocking jira_datacenter modules from importing adapters/jira, only the reverse direction
